title: Why No Bridge Can Cross This River | Ocean Science
description: The shocking truth behind the planet's most powerful water system. Discover the hidden forces that make this massive river unstoppable.
instagram_caption: This giant river is too powerful for any bridge to cross. Follow for more amazing secrets about our planet.

segments.narration: No bridge can cross this wild river because the water constantly shifts.
It pours more water into the sea than the next seven rivers combined.
Huge mountain walls force rain clouds to dump endless water onto the forest.

segments.narration: The flat landscape acts like a giant funnel for this massive rainfall.

segments.narration: The current is so violent that it pushes fresh water into the sea.
It dumps millions of tons of thick mud into the ocean every day.

segments.narration: This muddy plume is visible from space as it stains the blue Atlantic.
The wide mouth of this river is wider than the English Channel.
A giant ocean wave occasionally crashes backward up the river channel.

segments.narration: This powerful wave travels for miles and tears up entire trees along the banks.
